title: Egg
description: Butterflies start life as small eggs laid on leaves. The eggs are tiny and contain the developing caterpillar.

title: Caterpillar
description: The larvae hatch and grow quickly, shedding their skin several times while they eat leaves.

title: Chrysalis
description: Inside the chrysalis, the caterpillar transforms — tissue reorganizes and the butterfly forms.

title: Butterfly
description: A fully formed butterfly emerges, dries its wings, and flies off to feed and find a mate.
